title: Karya Bangsa Placement Detailed CEFR Rubrics
notice: Grammar & Vocabulary is scored automatically mapped to CEFR. Writing and Speaking are evaluated by administrators using 1–6 CEFR criteria. Listening comprehension is integrated into audio-format Speaking prompts.

bandScale.overall: Writing and Speaking: 0–1 = A1, 2–3 = A2, 4–5 = B1, 6–7 = B2, 8–9 = C1, 10 = C2

grammarVocabulary.title: GRAMMAR & VOCABULARY
grammarVocabulary.format: 50 Contextual Objective Items (1 point per item)

writing.title: WRITING
writing.format: 2 Tasks: Memo (120–150 words) and Discursive Essay (180–220 words) (20 Mins)
writing.weight: Administrator scores each of 4 criteria from (A1) to (C2).
writing.reviewNote: Evaluators grade responses against CEFR descriptors (1=A1, 2=A2, 3=B1, 4=B2, 5=C1).

descriptors: The topic is not developed at all, and writing seems to take enormous effort.
The purpose of the text and the writer’s aim are entirely unclear.
The text is not organised at either the paragraph or sentence level.
There is insufficient language control to express even very simple ideas.
There are very many errors in the use of language and standard writing conventions.
There is little or no use of appropriate vocabulary and structures.
The topic is not well developed, and writing seems to take considerable effort.
The purpose of the text and the writer’s aim are generally unclear.
The text is not well organised at either the paragraph or sentence level.
There is insufficient language control to express relatively simple ideas.
There are many errors in the use of language and standard writing conventions.
There is very limited use of appropriate vocabulary and structures.
The topic is quite well developed, although writing seems to take some effort.
The purpose of the text and the writer’s aim are not entirely clear.
The text is reasonably well organised, at least at the sentence level.
There is usually sufficient language control to express simple ideas.
There are some errors in the use of language and standard writing conventions.
There is limited use of appropriate vocabulary and structures.
The topic is well developed, and writing seems to take little effort.
The purpose of the text and the writer’s aim are generally clear.
The text is reasonably well organised at both the sentence and paragraph level.
There is sufficient language control to express simple ideas.
There are a few errors in the use of language and standard writing conventions.
The text contains a range of appropriate vocabulary and structures.
The topic is very well developed, and writing seems to take very little effort.
The purpose of the text and the writer’s aim are clear.
The text is well organised at both the sentence and paragraph level.
There is sufficient language control to express some quite complex ideas.
There are few errors in the use of language and standard writing conventions.
The text contains quite a wide range of appropriate vocabulary and structures.
The topic is fully developed, and writing seems effortless.
The purpose of the text and the writer’s aim are perfectly clear.
The text is extremely well organised at both the sentence and paragraph level.
There is sufficient language control to express a range of complex ideas.
There are almost no errors in the use of language and standard writing conventions.
The text contains a wide range of appropriate vocabulary and structures.

criteria.name: Task Achievement
criteria.description: How fully the essay addresses all elements of the prompt, sustains a focused pedagogical thesis, and substantiates claims with concrete examples.

criteria.name: Coherence and Cohesion
criteria.description: Clarity of essay structure, logical paragraph progression, effective use of transitional cohesive devices, and flow of argumentation.

criteria.name: Lexical Resource
criteria.description: Range, precision, sophistication, and stylistic appropriateness of academic vocabulary with minimal lexical inaccuracies.

criteria.name: Grammatical Range and Accuracy
criteria.description: Flexibility and accuracy of complex clause structures, punctuation mastery, grammatical control, and syntactic variety.

speaking.title: SPEAKING
speaking.format: 2-Part Recorded Audio/Video Interview with Audio-Format Prompts (20 Mins)
speaking.weight: Administrator scores each of 4 criteria from (A1) to (C2).
speaking.reviewNote: Evaluators review recorded video and audio streams to evaluate oral fluency, auditory prompt comprehension, grammatical control, and communicative efficacy.

passingRules.lulusLevel: Siswa berhasil mendapatkan skor minimal 3 (Good) pada pertanyaan di tingkat tersebut.
passingRules.belumMampu: Siswa mendapatkan skor 1 (Low) atau 2 (Fair) saat mencoba pertanyaan di tingkat berikutnya.

criteria.name: Fluency and Spontaneity
criteria.description: Natural speech rhythm, appropriate speaking rate, smooth transition between ideas, and effective hesitation management.

criteria.name: Listening Comprehension & Interaction
criteria.description: Accurate comprehension of spoken prompts, relevant topic engagement, and coherent communicative response.

criteria.name: Lexical & Idiomatic Range
criteria.description: Breadth, precision, and nuance of vocabulary used to discuss educational methodologies and abstract pedagogical issues.

criteria.name: Grammatical Complexity & Pronunciation
criteria.description: Accurate use of varied sentence structures, tense coordination, natural sentence intonation contours, and clear articulation.
